role: Free helpers: runWithTimeout (continuation race with FirstResultGate) used across the app, and the great-circle bearingDegrees.

units.does: Races an async throwing operation against a timer via a checked continuation and FirstResultGate: whichever finishes first resumes; errors become nil; on timeout resumes nil and cancels the work task.
calls: closure:operation — caller-supplied work (geocoder, MKLocalSearch, CloudKit, HealthKit queries)

flags.text: The timer task is never cancelled when the work finishes first, so every call leaves a task sleeping for the full timeout; the work task is unstructured and does not inherit the caller's cancellation (reset() cancelling a lookup does not stop an in-progress search).

units.does: Awaits the operation; on throw logs the error and returns nil.

branches.effect: error logged to debug log, swallowed, nil returned

units.does: Wraps the continuation in an OSAllocatedUnfairLock.
True once the stored continuation has been taken (resume called).
Atomically takes the continuation out of the lock and resumes it with the value; later calls find nil and do nothing.
Great-circle initial bearing from a to b, degrees [0,360).

flags.text: The same great-circle initial-bearing formula is written out five times: the global bearingDegrees, RoadAwarenessEngine.bearingDegrees (Point), SavedRouteStepBuilder.bearing, GetMeBackView.bearing and WorkoutGeometry.bearing (Route.Point).
